sloka: विरूप रूपा विकृता विवर्चसो ।महा आनना दीर्घ विरूप दर्शनाः ।समीक्ष्य सा राक्षस राज योषितो ।भयाद् विनष्टा जनक ईश्वर आत्मजा॥५-१२-४॥
transliteration: virūpa rūpā vikṛtā vivarcaso ।mahā ānanā dīrgha virūpa darśanāḥ ।samīkṣya sā rākṣasa rāja yoṣito ।bhayād vinaṣṭā janaka īśvara ātmajā॥5-12-4॥

translations.english: 'The daughter of Janaka might have collapsed out of fear, looking at the distorted faces of ugly, tall and monstrous demon maids of Ravana.
